subject: Company C
subject_description: Early-stage BCMA-directed cell therapy platform, UK-domiciled
domain: Immuno-oncology · Multiple Myeloma · TCE + autologous CAR-T
disclaimer: Anonymized specimen. Subject-asset and client identities are redacted. Comparator, market, regulatory, and IP data are unredacted at primary source. This surface exposes evidence, model treatment, and revision triggers; it does not fabricate unsupported valuation inputs.

findings.title: Market concentration raises the share-capture hurdle before differentiation is proven.
findings.statement: 210 of 268 (78%) active programs are BCMA-directed; five of six approved products use BCMA.
findings.current_treatment: crowding burden remains in the base case

findings.title: The precedent set does not support a broad probability uplift.
findings.statement: Five of 34 recorded outcomes fall inside the construct-level slice the platform addresses; 29 sit outside it. Twenty carry strategic or corporate reasons as stated, not established causation.
findings.revision_trigger: asset-specific evidence against dominant failure modes

findings.title: The next catalyst must clear a visible durability hurdle.
findings.statement: Named comparator median PFS spans 7.5 to 34.9 months across separate trials and populations; the reconstructions are benchmarks, not head-to-head forecasts.

findings.title: Post-market signals remain an adoption, monitoring, and liability variable.
findings.statement: The record contains 17,540 spontaneous reports across seven products. Counts lack exposure denominators and cannot rank products.
findings.current_treatment: no cross-product ranking from report counts

findings.title: Exclusivity remains conditional because sequence evidence is not a legal opinion.
findings.statement: Maximum identity versus Celyad claimed CDRs is 47%; higher short-sequence hits sit against an unclaimed comparator.

findings.title: Public filings show financing preparation, not a completed new round.
findings.statement: Three post-2022 allotment authorities have no matching SH01; public filings do not establish round size, runway, valuation, or fully diluted ownership.
findings.revision_trigger: cap table, financing documents, or new SH01

findings.title: The public disclosure supports a narrower asset perimeter than the positioning.
findings.statement: The NeurIPS workshop preprint supports a binder-maturation result but does not disclose primary T-cell functional data or multispecific architecture.

findings.title: The uncorroborated pipeline claim stays outside the base case.
findings.statement: CB-101 and a Q1 2027 clinic-entry claim appear in one conference biography with no second venue across seven groups searched.
findings.revision_trigger: independent second source plus underlying evidence

sources_list: Conference abstracts (ASH, ASCO, EHA, SITC, AACR)
